title: Fast Lane onboarding — announce draft (scratch)
content:
Objective:
This is a rough internal draft announcing the new Fast Lane onboarding offering — a concierge, accelerated onboarding path for high-priority Dedicated/Private customers aimed at getting them to SLA-backed production in 4 weeks. Use this as the source for a short Slack + email announcement, 5-minute all-hands talking points, and a quick Q&A for CS/SEs.

Key one-liner (SLACK/EMAIL):
We’re launching Fast Lane — a concierge onboarding service for select Dedicated and Private customers that bundles priority provisioning, tailored rollout plans, and a dedicated onboarding lead to reach production-ready SLAs in ~4 weeks. Sign-up details and eligibility below.

Top talking points (for exec/all-hands):
- Why: Customers repeatedly ask for faster, lower-friction paths to production; Fast Lane reduces time-to-SLA and lowers churn risk for strategic deals.
- What: A 4-week, hands-on program: priority capacity allocation, a named onboarding lead (SE + PM), standard playbook + custom rollout work, and bi-weekly success checkpoints.
- Who qualifies: Strategic customers with a committed quarterly spend or customers converting from pilot to Dedicated/Private with high risk/reward.
- Ops guardrails: Limited slots per month, standard intake checklist, and playbook templates to keep cost bounded.
- Outcome: Predictable time-to-SLA, improved NPS at launch, and fewer ad-hoc support escalations.

Suggested Slack announcement (short):
Heads-up: we’re piloting Fast Lane — a concierge onboarding program for prioritized Dedicated & Private customers to reach production SLAs in ~4 weeks. CS/SEs: nominate candidates here (link) or ping @Rowan. Internal FAQ and intake form: (confluence link).

Suggested email to select prospects (short):
Subject: Accelerate your Redwood deployment with Fast Lane
Hello <Name>,
We’re offering a new Fast Lane onboarding track to help teams like yours move from pilot to production faster. It includes priority capacity, a dedicated onboarding lead, and a custom rollout plan. If you’re interested we can schedule a 30-min intake to confirm fit.

Q&A (for CS/SEs and sales):
Q: How many customers can we support?
A: Pilot capacity is 6 slots/month. We’ll scale based on demand and playbook maturity.
Q: What’s included vs. paid services?
A: Fast Lane covers priority infra, onboarding hours (up to defined cap), and playbook templates. Custom engineering beyond scope is quoted as professional services.
Q: SLA guarantees?
A: Customers get production SLO targets based on Dedicated offering; SLA paperwork is part of the intake if they sign a committed reservation.
Q: Who runs the program?
A: GTM owns enrollment and customer success; Eng (platform + serving-runtime) supports provisioning and escalations.

Presenter notes (for 5-min all-hands mention):
- Open: 30s high-level "why" — customers need fast, reliable onboarding to ship features.
- Middle: 2 min bullets on what Fast Lane is and a quick success metric we want (time-to-SLA, NPS).
- Close: 1 min call-to-action to CS/SEs to nominate candidates and to Eng to expect prioritized provisioning requests.

Operational checklist (short):
- Intake form ready (confluence + Jira intake ticket template)
- Pre-approved capacity pool flagged in infra (ops ticket)
- Onboarding playbook checklist published (template + runbook)
- Billing/account team aware of reservation/commit process

Open questions to resolve before final launch:
- Exact quota and cross-team escalation flow (need SRE + infra sign-off).
- Pricing boundaries for included engineering hours vs billable PS.
- Metrics to track for initial 3 months (time-to-SLA, launch NPS, escalations).

Next steps (owner + ETA):
- Finalize intake form and playbook (Owner: Lena; ETA: Mar 16)
- Confirm infra pool and provision process (Owner: Rowan; ETA: Mar 12)
- Align finance/pricing guardrails (Owner: Mikaela; ETA: Mar 18)
- Draft public-facing landing + sales one-pager (Owner: GTM content; ETA: Mar 22)

Notes-to-self / rough items:
- Keep announcement concise — avoid operational detail in the all-hands 1-liner.
- Have a one-slide summary for the sales toolkit (1 pager + TL;DR).
- Track early pilots as case studies for Q2 content.

-- end scratch --
